column1: # Line-hash exceptions for the denylist scanner.
# path is exact and repo-relative: no globs (* ? [), no leading slash, no ..
# line_sha256 is the SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase) of the UTF-8 line text
# with the line ending already stripped — the same string Python's
# str.splitlines() yields. Trailing spaces and other whitespace are included.
# An entry suppresses only that named rule, on the line whose hash matches,
# Only content-classed rules may be excepted. Path, host, and userpath
# rules cannot, and a rule with no CLASS cannot.
# Stale entries, malformed rows, hash mismatches, and wrong-rule rows
# This file is itself scanned; do not put a denied token in the reason.
